s2.text: Welcome to Catchami — a living animal economy!

s3a.text: It starts in the real world. Find an animal, throw your CamiCube, and turn a successful catch into a playable NFT.

s4a.text: Now, give your pet a life.

s4b.text: Explore, gather resources, and earn coins.

s4c.text: But every action costs energy. And every pet gets hungry.

s5b.text: Prices change as pets gather, consume, and trade.

s5c.text: Find a travelling merchant, and turn your work into coins!

s6b.text: Challenge another pet in Bubble Roulette!

s6c.text: Win resources and coins... or end up completely soaked!

s7b.text: Buy food. Recover with medicine. Craft equipment. Trade what you create.

s7c.text: And every purchase changes the economy.

s8b.text: Your pet can run its own little business.

s8c.text: Set its strategy, and it will gather, find merchants, trade, rest, and look after itself, even when you're not controlling it.

s9a.text: Behind it all is a living economy.

s9b.text: HQ collects what players spend, funds the travelling merchants, and adjusts their budgets as the treasury and market change.

s9c.text: Every coin has a source. Every expense has a destination.

s10.text: Real NFTs. A token balance inside every pet. Gameplay, settled on NEAR.

s11b.text: Catch a pet. Give it a life.
